heading: The minimum bar for a low-latency claim that survives real conditions
body: After testing 14 bot and broker pairs over six months, only one pattern held up under live load: signals routed through a co-located gateway, paired with a broker that publishes per-account rate limits and supports WebSocket order push. Everything else is marketing.

answer_card.label: Verified threshold
answer_card.answer: Co-located gateway + WebSocket broker + published rate limits

hook: Knowing the bar is one thing — meeting it is the next step.
